sources.entry: MacVim - the text editor Vim - for macOS. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/macvim-dev/macvim) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: MacVim is a macOS graphical version of the Vim text editor, a downstream fork of Vim that adds native macOS integration.
summary.what_it_does: MacVim provides a native GUI for Vim on macOS, with menus, dialog boxes, toolbars, and scroll bars. It supports native and non-native full-screen modes, and lets trackpad gestures, Touch Bar, and Command-key shortcuts be mapped to Vim actions. It integrates with macOS system services, dictionary lookup, and Apple Intelligence Writing Tools. It adds Vim GUI tabs with customizable colors, font ligatures, and accurate text rendering. The project routinely merges from upstream Vim, and the Homebrew `macvim` package also provides a terminal version of Vim.
use_cases: edit code or text in a native macOS editor window
use Vim keybindings with a graphical interface on a Mac
map trackpad gestures or Touch Bar buttons to editor commands
open and edit files from the Dock or terminal with mvim
use Vim with ligature fonts and tabbed windows
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the Releases page on GitHub
Build from source following the Building MacVim guide
notable: Native macOS GUI for Vim with menus, toolbars, and full-screen support
Trackpad gestures, Touch Bar, and Command-key shortcuts mappable to Vim actions
Integration with macOS services, dictionary lookup, and Apple Intelligence Writing Tools
Downstream fork that regularly merges upstream Vim changes
caveats: Released under the Vim License rather than a standard open-source license
